description: Extracts a capitalized multi-word name-like phrase from the question, skipping phrases that begin with common function words (determiners, prepositions, question words) that are not names, and counts whole-word (word-boundary) occurrences of each surface form across the snippets, reporting only verbatim standalone matches.
header: Counts whole-word occurrences of a question-named entity's surface forms across snippets.
